messages.subject: NVD3 Legend
parts:
I am unable to remove the legend from a NVD3 plot.  I am able to get the plot to work when I just use the first line of code, but when I add the second line to remove the legend I get the following error:

Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : attempt to apply non-function

Below is a snippet of my server.R

           p4 <- nPlot(Weights ~ Assets, data = assets, type = 'pieChart') 
           p4$chart( donut = TRUE, showLegend = FALSE)

Thanks,
Josh
